day_shape: 52 items: Rubio confirms progress but no deal on Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz shipping talks, Reuters reports US ATACMS/PrSM stocks nearly depleted in five-month Iran war, State Department imposes INKSNA nonproliferation measures, and Iran International reports Mojtaba Khamenei warned Pezeshkian a further resignation would be accepted.

threads.label: Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz shipping talks
threads.summary: Rubio said talks between Iran and Oman on reopening Strait of Hormuz shipping have progressed but no final agreement is reached, with Jerusalem Post citing sources saying terms lie in Iran's favour. IRIB's Bagheri said negotiations continue and an informed source told Press TV a deal is within reach absent US 'sabotage'; Aramco's CEO said Hormuz flows are at a tenth of pre-conflict levels.

threads.label: US missile stocks depleted after Iran war
threads.summary: Reuters reported the US Army has used 'virtually all' of its ATACMS and Precision Strike Missile stocks during the five-month war with Iran, per two sources familiar with the data. IRIB amplified the report and Iran's military advisor Mohsen Rezaei claimed on Press TV that Iranian strikes in July killed hundreds of US soldiers.

threads.label: Pezeshkian–Mojtaba Khamenei succession reporting
threads.summary: Iran International reported President Pezeshkian was driven to a secret Tehran location and seated in a car with tinted windows beside a voice presented as the supreme leader. Jerusalem Post reported Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei warned Pezeshkian any further resignation attempt would be accepted; Khamenei's office and Defa Press issued statements denying circulating claims about a response to the president's letter.

threads.label: Arbaeen pilgrimage logistics and diplomacy
threads.summary: Defa Press cited Karbala's governor claiming 22 million pilgrims took part in Arbaeen and Iran's Central Arbaeen Command reported over 3.34 million Iranians crossed borders, with Commander Radan allocating over 1,000 return buses. Foreign Minister Araghchi attended Dhuhr prayers at the Imam Hussain shrine and met the governors of Karbala and Basra and Badr Organisation's Hadi al-Ameri on the sidelines.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon track and regional strikes
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Israel and Lebanon resumed talks in Rome as Hezbollah's Naim Qassem denounced negotiations and accused President Aoun of abandoning a unifying role, while IDF Arabic spokesman Adraee addressed 'Hassan' on clearing southern Lebanon of Hezbollah. The IDF said it dismantled 10 weapons-production machines in Qabatiya, and Defa Press reported a Yemeni armed forces drone strike on Najran airport in Saudi Arabia.

events.title_en: Iran-Oman talks on Strait of Hormuz continue
events.summary_en: Iran-Oman talks on Strait of Hormuz continue. The Foreign Ministry spokesman reported the continuation of Iran-Oman negotiations aimed at organising safe maritime transit through the Strait of Hormuz. Bagheri in a conversation with IRIB news agency: these negotiations, as talks between two littoral states of the Strait of Hormuz, are being pursued with a focus on defining safe shipping routes in and out; routes that whilst ensuring sovereignty rights, also take into account Iran and Oman's national security considerations. The talks have so far been assessed positively at both technical and political levels, and Iran is seeking, in cooperation with Oman, to establish the necessary mechanisms for future arrangements to manage maritime transit through this strategic passage.

events.summary_en: 22 million pilgrims participate in Arbaeen ceremonies. Nasif al-Khattabi, Governor of Karbala, announced today, Tuesday, that 22 million pilgrims participated in the Arbaeen ceremonies of the Master and Leader of Martyrs this year. Saad Ma'an, head of Iraq's security media centre, also reported the success of the Arbaeen ceremony plan in the country. events.title_en: The Husseini uprising, the pinnacle of history in the confrontation between truth and falsehood
events.summary_en: The Husseini uprising, the pinnacle of history in the confrontation between truth and falsehood. An excerpt from the message of His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Leader of the Revolution: the Husseini movement and uprising, to establish truth and reform the nation and confront oppression and tyranny, is the pinnacle of history in the confrontation between truth and falsehood, and justice and oppression, and contains lessons of immense value and unforgettable significance for all the free peoples of the world. The blood of the Master of Martyrs, peace be upon him, is called the blood of God, which flows through the veins of the world and creates life-giving epics. The Islamic Revolution and movement of Iran, being a branch stemming from this luminous source, must always be in pursuit of achieving the objectives of the Husseini uprising.

events.title_en: An informed source to Press TV: Negotiations with the Omani side have entered a new phase for more than two weeks and if US sabotage and that of some other parties stops, an Iran-Oman agreement is within reach
events.summary_en: An informed source to Press TV: negotiations with the Omani side have entered a new phase for more than two weeks and if US sabotage and that of some other parties stops, an Iran-Oman agreement is within reach. Iran pursued its commitment according to clause 5 of the understanding note in consultation with Oman and talks with other regional countries seriously and was expected to reach a result within the 30-day timeframe stipulated in clause 5. However, unfortunately US interventions and sabotage by some regional countries disrupted this process. The objective of these negotiations is to reach agreement on a new corridor that would secure Iran's sovereignty rights and considerations as a littoral state harmed by US misuse.

events.title_en: Increase in attacks and insults against Christians in occupied Jerusalem
events.summary_en: Increase in attacks and insults against Christians in occupied Jerusalem. The Wall Street Journal has reported that harassment of Christians in occupied Jerusalem, particularly in the Old City, has increased. These actions mainly consist of spitting, insulting and threatening clergy, nuns and Christian religious centres, to the extent that some nuns, out of fear, do not leave their residence without accompaniment. At least 107 anti-Christian incidents were recorded in the first half of 2026, more than double the same period in 2024. Religious rights activists say most of these cases go unpunished and Zionist authorities take no serious action to counter them.

events.summary_en: Analytical note: managing harmful vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Dr Hassan Abidin, senior international affairs expert and political deputy of IRIB, wrote in a note: Iran, despite having less actually and practically used the Strait of Hormuz in 47 years for safeguarding national security, has in this time, due to military threats from enemies, drawn on all its capacity for legitimate defence. The Islamic Republic of Iran faces three options regarding the Strait of Hormuz, each with different timescales and consequences.

events.title_en: Denial of a claim regarding the Leader of the Revolution's response to the President's letter
events.summary_en: Denial of a claim regarding the Leader of the Revolution's response to the President's letter. The public relations office of the Office of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution stressed in a statement; the official source for the publication of messages, news and matters related to Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, his office and the office for the preservation and publication of the Leader of the Revolution's works, is the official source, and any content outside this framework lacks authenticity and accuracy. The text of the public relations office statement of the Office of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Commemorating the Arbaeen of Hussain and honouring the exalted spirit of the martyred leader of the revolution, we hereby inform the esteemed people and officials of Iran that in recent days some quotations from the esteemed Leader of the Islamic Revolution have been circulated in cyberspace.

The text of the public relations office statement of the Office of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Commemorating the Arbaeen of Hussain and honouring the exalted spirit of the martyred leader of the revolution, we hereby inform the esteemed people and officials of Iran that in recent days some quotations from the esteemed Leader of the Islamic Revolution have been circulated in cyberspace which unfortunately created grounds for disturbing public minds.

events.title_en: Washington Post: cost of National Guard presence in Washington 1.4 billion dollars; Senator Warren: taxpayers' money is not for Trump's political embellishments!
events.summary_en: Washington Post: cost of National Guard presence in Washington 1.4 billion dollars; Senator Warren: taxpayers' money is not for Trump's political embellishments! A recent estimate shows that continuing to deploy National Guard forces in Washington until the end of Trump's term will cost an additional 1.4 billion dollars for American taxpayers. This figure is separate from the hundreds of millions of dollars already spent on this mission; and this at a time when the US Department of Defense faces budget shortages. Elizabeth Warren, Democratic senator, has called this action a showcase of Trump's political theatre. Police statistics also show that violent crime in Washington has not declined noticeably.

events.title_en: Reuters: US long-range precision missile stocks have been severely depleted in war with Iran
events.summary_en: Reuters: US long-range precision missile stocks have been severely depleted in war with Iran. Reuters reported, citing several informed sources, that the US military, during the five-month war with Iran, has consumed a large portion of its long-range missile stocks. According to these sources, the US has used almost all land-based long-range missiles of the ATACMS and PrSM type and has also used nearly half of its global Tomahawk cruise missile stocks. Based on this report, the reduction in missile stocks has caused concern among some US officials; as the readiness of this country's military for possible other crises, including against Russia or China, may be limited.

events.title_en: Pourjamshidian: water consumption management improves the quality of Arbaeen services
events.summary_en: Pourjamshidian: water consumption management improves the quality of Arbaeen services. Head of the Central Arbaeen Command, whilst emphasising that the provision of safe and sustainable water is the most important service to pilgrims at the Arbaeen borders, said: scientific management of water consumption, whilst ensuring pilgrims' sustainable access to this vital need, provides the necessary resources to strengthen infrastructure and improve other Arbaeen services. Development of pilgrims' access to sustainable drinking water and the use of water coolers should be given attention, and pilgrims too, by carrying water bottles and using the safe water available at the borders, can play an effective role in water consumption management.

events.title_en: The continuation of the uprising of God's avenger
events.summary_en: The continuation of the uprising of God's avenger. Peace be upon you, O avenger of God and son of he whose blood was avenged, and the wronged claim. Peace be upon you and upon your grandfather and father and mother and brother and the infallible ones among your offspring. Greetings to the Imam whose uprising's cry of life-giving, reverberating and resounding echo extended through the annals of distant history and from its effect the Islamic Revolution of Iran emerged. A revolution that was Husseini in its foundation and was built and grew with the slogan and principle of Hussain. From a message from the esteemed Leader of the Revolution on the occasion of the funeral and burial of the Martyr of Iran.
